ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with a ratio of approximately 13:7 high-intensity (white) pixels in the central regions to low-intensity (black) pixels along the perimeter and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous high-intensity (white) ellipsoidal regions situated in the center of the left and right lobes; bounded by a low-intensity (black) border extending from the trailing edge. Multiple low-intensity focal spots (<10px) are distributed non-uniformly within the high-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth equivalent to ~18% of the maximum lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous linear boundary; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude varies between 3 and 7 pixels, with more pronounced jaggedness on the right lobe distal margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight concavity toward the distal tips, forming a standard sigmoid-like sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of low-intensity (dark) circular pixel clusters on the distal portion of the right lobe and lower-central region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three distinct, parallel low-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) oriented at a ~45-degree angle across the central-left lobe pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible rake marks on the left lobe; irregular pigmentation erosion and notch-like deformations along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant asymmetric low-intensity pigmentation encroachment on the right lobe trailing edge compared to the relatively thin border on the left lobe.
